title: MLAlgo-Bench: Can Machines Implement Machine Learning Algorithms?
authors_zh: Yunfei Wang, Yeqin Zhang, Yuyang Wu, Liang Lu, Phi Le Nguyen, Xiaoliang Wang, Cam-Tu Nguyen
paper_type_zh: 机器学习算法实现与运行验证基准
best_for_zh: 需要评估机器学习算法代码生成、性能约束或可执行实验复现的研究者。
one_line: MLAlgo-Bench tests machine-learning algorithm implementation with sandboxed execution, performance references, and runtime-aware validation.
MLAlgo-Bench 以算法实现和真实应用两类任务检验机器学习代码，使用沙箱执行、性能参照和时间开销自动验证。
why: It exposes a rerunnable outcome-verification surface rather than a text-only reference answer.
inclusion_reason: The release pairs tasks with an executable or formal terminal verification contract.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Function-level code benchmarks mainly test whether short programs pass unit tests. They do not measure implementation of complete machine-learning algorithms, configuration of training procedures, reproduction of paper details, or execution of Kaggle solution plans. ML code also depends on numerical performance, runtime, random seeds, and data processing, so mere executability can incorrectly accept weak or degenerate implementations.

MLAlgo-Bench asks whether models can translate complex human algorithm descriptions and solution sketches into executable ML implementations with reasonable performance. It separates algorithm implementation from practical competition-solution implementation and evaluates execution, relative predictive performance, and time overhead automatically.

函数级代码 benchmark 主要测试短程序是否通过单元测试，不能反映模型实现完整机器学习算法、配置训练过程、复现论文细节或完成 Kaggle 方案的能力。ML 代码还同时受数值性能、运行时间、随机种子和数据处理影响，仅检查“脚本能运行”会把低质量或退化实现误判为成功。

MLAlgo-Bench 要回答模型能否把复杂的人类算法描述和方案草图转化为可执行、性能合理的 ML 实现。论文把任务拆为算法实现和实际竞赛方案实现两类，并提供自动运行、相对性能和时间开销评测。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
MLAlgo-Bench contains two parts: 121 implementation tasks spanning traditional and deep-learning algorithms, and 97 practical tasks based on Kaggle-style scenarios. Algorithm tasks require implementation of models or optimization procedures from complex descriptions. Practical tasks provide a human solution sketch, data, and an execution environment and require complete training, inference, and submission code.

Each task includes a reference implementation, data interface, execution scripts, and performance baselines. Metrics include task pass rate, relative performance, and time overhead. The data object is therefore not a simple prompt–code pair but a task or solution sketch linked to an executable environment, model submission, and measured performance, supporting evaluation of long instruction understanding and multi-stage ML programming.

MLAlgo-Bench 包含两部分：121 个传统与深度学习算法实现任务，以及 97 个面向 Kaggle 场景的实战任务。算法任务要求按复杂说明实现模型或优化过程；实战任务向模型提供人类 solution sketch、数据和运行环境，要求完成训练、推理与提交代码。

每个任务配参考实现、数据接口、执行脚本和性能基线，评测指标包括 task pass rate、相对性能和时间开销。其数据对象不是简单 prompt—code 对，而是“任务说明/方案—代码环境—可运行提交—性能结果”，适合评测长指令理解和多阶段 ML 编程。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Prepare algorithm tasks: One hundred twenty-one algorithms are selected from textbooks, papers, and common ML libraries. Specifications describe inputs, outputs, formulas, components, and training requirements, with executable references and test data.
  1. Construct practical tasks: Ninety-seven Kaggle-style problems are selected. Human approaches are compressed into solution sketches that do not reveal complete code, while data splits, submission formats, and resource constraints are provided.
  1. Build execution environments: Dependencies, datasets, and hardware budgets are fixed, and generated code is executed. Compilation or runtime failure, malformed outputs, and timeouts are recorded separately rather than merged into prediction errors.
  1. Score comprehensively: Task completion is checked first, then predictive performance is normalized against references and runtime is measured. Reproduction requires fixed seeds, data versions, libraries, hardware, and permitted training time.

1. 整理算法任务： 从教材、论文和常用 ML 库选择 121 个算法，编写包含输入输出、公式、模块和训练要求的说明，并准备可运行参考代码与测试数据。
  1. 构造实战任务： 从 Kaggle 类问题选择 97 个任务，将人类方案压缩为不直接泄漏完整代码的 solution sketch，提供数据划分、提交格式和资源限制。
  1. 建立执行环境： 为任务安装依赖、固定数据和硬件预算，运行模型生成代码；编译/运行失败、输出格式错误或超时分别记录，而不是统一当成预测错误。
  1. 综合评分： 先判断任务是否完成，再将模型指标与参考性能归一化，并统计运行时间。复现需要固定随机种子、数据版本、库、GPU/CPU 和容许训练时长。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
In the public evaluation, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, the strongest system, completes 48.8% of algorithm-implementation tasks but only 21.6% of Kaggle practical tasks. The large gap shows that implementing an isolated algorithm does not imply successful coordination of data processing, training, tuning, prediction, and submission in an end-to-end solution.

Automatic execution also records relative performance and time, preventing code that runs but predicts near random from being treated as fully successful. This supports the benchmark’s discriminative value for complex ML programming, although results depend on hardware, randomness, and API versions, so performance variance cannot be attributed entirely to model reasoning.

在公开评测中，表现最好的 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在算法实现任务上的完成率为 48.8%，在 Kaggle 实战任务上只有 21.6%。两类结果的明显落差说明模型即使能实现独立算法，也难以完成数据处理、训练、调参、预测和提交相互耦合的端到端方案。

自动执行同时记录相对性能和时间，使“运行成功但预测接近随机”不能获得完整肯定。该证据支持 benchmark 对复杂 ML 编程具有区分度，但结果受硬件、随机性和 API 版本影响；同一代码的性能差异不能全部归因于模型推理。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Benchmarks such as DS-1000 and HumanEval focus on short functions and deterministic tests, while MLE-bench emphasizes autonomous competition agents without supplying human solution sketches. MLAlgo-Bench directly tests whether a model can follow a complex algorithm specification or professional solution sketch and produce a multi-step, performance-sensitive implementation.

Its novelty is not the first execution of generated code. It combines functional completion, relative model quality, and computational cost in one protocol and spans both implementation of known algorithms and realization of human competition strategies. This separates syntax-level coding, algorithm understanding, and engineering integration.

已有 DS-1000、HumanEval 等工作主要以短函数和确定性测试为中心；MLE-bench 更偏 agent 自主竞赛，但不给定人类方案草图。MLAlgo-Bench 的变化是直接考查模型能否遵循复杂算法说明或专业 solution sketch，生成多步骤、性能敏感的实现。

其新意不在首次运行模型代码，而在把功能完成、相对模型质量和计算成本组成同一评测协议，并同时覆盖“实现已知算法”和“实现人类竞赛策略”两个难度层级。这样可以区分代码语法能力、算法理解和工程集成能力。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Performance nondeterminism: ML training depends on seeds, hardware, threading, library versions, and numerical precision. Single-run relative performance can be unstable, requiring multiple seeds and variance reporting.
  1. External data rights: Kaggle-style datasets and solutions have task-specific licenses and access rules. Public benchmark files may not grant unrestricted redistribution of raw data, so each task must be checked before reuse.
  1. Solution-sketch boundary: The detail level of a sketch determines difficulty. Excess detail reduces the task to code translation, while too little turns it into open research. Comparisons require identical prompts, runtime, and resource budgets.

1. 性能非确定性： ML 训练受随机种子、硬件、线程、库版本和数值精度影响；单次运行的相对性能可能不稳定，应至少多种子重复并报告方差。
  1. 外部数据权利： Kaggle 类数据与方案可能有各自许可和访问规则，公开文件不一定包含可无限再分发的原始数据；复用前需逐任务核查。
  1. 方案提示边界： solution sketch 的细节决定任务难度，过详细会接近代码翻译，过简略则变成开放研究。比较模型时必须使用完全相同的 prompt、时间和资源预算。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluate ML coding agents: Test algorithm implementation and practical solutions separately, reporting completion rate, relative performance, timeout rate, and resource cost rather than executability alone.
  1. Construct SFT data: Organize specifications, reference code, execution results, and performance diagnostics into training records. Negative examples should distinguish syntax errors, leakage, inadequate performance, and timeouts.
  1. Train with execution feedback: Agents can revise code from runtime errors and metrics, but training and evaluation must fix the maximum number of iterations and GPU time. The benchmark is unnecessarily expensive for ordinary function generation but provides a realistic verifier for research and AutoML agents.

1. ML code agent 评测： 分别测算法实现和实战方案，报告 completion rate、相对性能、超时率和资源开销，避免只看代码是否运行。
  1. SFT 数据构造： 将任务说明、参考代码、执行结果和性能诊断组织为训练记录；生成负样本时应区分语法错、数据泄漏、性能不足和超时。
  1. 执行反馈训练： agent 可根据报错和指标迭代修改代码，但训练与评测需固定最大轮数和 GPU 时间。若目标只是普通函数生成，MLAlgo-Bench 成本过高；若目标是科研或 AutoML agent，它提供更接近真实工作的 verifier。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: MLAlgo-Bench uses 121 algorithms and 97 practical tasks to test whether complex ML descriptions can become executable, competitive code.
  2. Method takeaway: Write algorithm and solution specifications, prepare data and references, execute in isolation, and jointly measure completion, relative performance, and runtime.
  3. Data takeaway: Both tracks include executable environments rather than static prompt–code pairs.
  4. Evidence anchor: The best model completes 48.8% of algorithm tasks but only 21.6% of practical tasks, showing that end-to-end integration is much harder.
  5. Reuse decision: It is suitable for ML-agent evaluation; randomness and resource comparability are the main risks, requiring fixed environments and repeated seeds.

1. 一句话定位： MLAlgo-Bench 用 121 个算法和 97 个实战任务测试模型能否把复杂 ML 说明转成可运行且性能合理的代码。
  2. 方法抓手： 编写算法/方案描述、准备数据与参考实现、隔离执行、同时评估完成率、相对性能和时间。
  3. 数据抓手： 两类任务均包含可执行环境，不是普通静态 prompt—code benchmark。
  4. 证据锚点： 最佳模型算法任务完成 48.8%，实战任务仅 21.6%，端到端集成明显更难。
  5. 复用决定： 适合 ML agent 评测；最大风险是随机性和资源不可比，必须固定环境并多种子运行。
